name: no-extension
purpose: the no-extension path: pipelines with no slots, the same route through the core as any other. No default is chosen by it; it is written out

name: content-filter-is-not-approval
purpose: the observation scope selects api-server and excludes curl. A content rule - the authorization header removed before anything is retained - applies to the records of approved instances only: a process running /usr/bin/curl that sends credentials is never inspected, because approval is decided before plaintext is copied and the removal runs after capture on records of approved instances

name: configuration-only-pack
purpose: a configuration-only pack that supplies no implementation and reverses the operator's two masking steps: the operator replaces the authorization value and then truncates it; the pack's replacements select truncation for the first slot and replacement for the second, so the value kept is the pack's marker rather than the first eight bytes of the operator's
